item.title: Paul Wolfe Breaks Down Bassline Writing in New Book Deliberate Composition for Bass Guitar
item.description: Bass educator Paul Wolfe releases "Deliberate Composition" for Bass Guitar, a step-by-step method for writing basslines using chord movement and rhythm.

item.title: D’Addario Introduces XPND Core Pedalboards for Streamlined Pedal Rigs
item.description: D’Addario expands its XPND line with new Core Pedalboards, offering fixed aluminum frames, cable management, and expansion-ready designs.

item.title: Michael League x Nate Smith: A London Performance That Hits Hard
item.description: Michael League’s vintage P Bass tone and subtle effects choices add real character to this hour long London set with Nate Smith, creating a laid back and engaging performance.

item.title: Weekly Top 10: Höfner Addresses Insolvency, SansAmp Classic Returns, and a Lost Big Muff Circuit Resurfaces
item.description: Höfner responds to insolvency news, Tech 21 announces a SansAmp Classic reissue, and a lost Big Muff circuit resurfaces in this week’s Top 10 stories.

item.title: Marco Mendoza Anchors SatchVai Band as Satriani and Vai Announce Spring 2026 U.S. Tour
item.description: Joe Satriani and Steve Vai bring the SatchVai Band to the U.S. in spring 2026, joined by Marco Mendoza, Kenny Aronoff, and Animals As Leaders.

item.title: Watch Jean-Michel Labadie and His Sandberg Bass Ignite Gojira’s Live “Stranded” at Bloodstock 2025
item.description: Gojira closes Bloodstock with a fiery performance of Stranded featuring Jean Michel Labadie and his signature Sandberg in a powerful live festival finale.

item.title: Storywood Music Unveils SWB-3 50s Style P Bass Built From 100% Reclaimed Wood
item.description: Storywood Music debuts the SWB-3 50s Style P Bass, crafted from 100% reclaimed wood with dual Aguilar P51 pickups and expanded tonal options.

item.title: Nina DeCesare to Perform All Six Bach Cello Suites on Tour This February
item.description: Baltimore Symphony bassist Nina DeCesare will tour this February performing all six Bach Cello Suites on the double bass, with stops nationwide.

item.title: Brian Bromberg Takes the Upright Bass Center Stage on “Autumn Leaves” with His Acoustic Trio
item.description: Enjoy Brian Bromberg’s upright bass at the center of this live Autumn Leaves performance recorded in Tucson where his trio delivers a warm blend of melody rhythm and subtle energy.

item.title: Gamechanger Audio Introduces Recoder, a Sample-Based Pedal That Rewrites Your Tone in Real Time
item.description: Recoder is Gamechanger Audio’s new sample-driven effects pedal, allowing players to record sounds and transform their tone in real time.
